load_c2_pickled_weights: load Caffe2 pickled weights from a file path into a Python dictionary
rename_basic_resnet_weights: rename Caffe2 ResNet layer weight keys to PyTorch torchvision-compatible naming conventions
rename_weights_for_resnet: remap Caffe2 ResNet weights including FPN, Mask R-CNN, and Keypoint R-CNN keys
load_resnet_c2_format: load and convert Caffe2 ResNet pretrained weights for R-50, R-101, or R-152 backbone models
load_c2_format: load Caffe2 format weights using the registered backbone CONV_BODY configuration key
